title: Modified CTAB Method for Simultaneous RNA Extraction from Conifer Plants
author: Clarissa Lopez Del Visco
materials: Carefully remove and discard the ETOH.

steps.title: Prepare frozen tissue samples
steps.instruction: Retrieve frozen plant tissue from the –80 °C freezer, place the pieces on ice or a cold rack, and keep them immersed in liquid nitrogen (LN₂) until further processing.

steps.title: Add beta‑mercaptoethanol
steps.instruction: Inside a chemical hood, add 20 µL of 2.67 % β‑mercaptoethanol to each sample tube.

steps.title: Add warm CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat a water bath and a dry thermal bath to 65 °C, then heat the CTAB extraction buffer to 65 °C. Add 750 µL of the warm CTAB buffer to each sample tube.

steps.title: Grind tissue to fine powder
steps.instruction: Sterilize mortar and pestle in an autoclave (work in batches of 12–24). Place the frozen tissue in a pre‑chilled mortar, add LN₂, and grind with the pestle until a very fine powder is obtained, adding LN₂ as needed to keep the sample cold.

steps.title: Transfer powder to screw‑cap tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the fine powder into a sterile screw‑cap tube (e.g., Falcon 15 mL tube) – avoid microcentrifuge caps that may pop when warmed. Store the tubes at –80 °C until the next step.

steps.title: Mix and incubate CTAB extraction
steps.instruction: Invert the tubes gently (do not shake) to ensure the CTAB buffer contacts all powder. Incubate in the dry thermal bath at 65 °C for 10 min, inverting once after 5 min.

steps.title: First chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube, invert gently, then centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 20 min at room temperature (centrifuge placed in the hood). Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 2 mL microcentrifuge tube; discard the remaining liquid.

steps.title: Second chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add another 750 µL of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube, centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 20 min at room temperature, and transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube; discard the remaining liquid.

steps.title: LiCl precipitation overnight
steps.instruction: Add 1/4 volume of 10 M LiCl to each tube, place the tubes in a styrofoam box filled with ice, then move the box to a 4 °C refrigerator or cold room and let the mixture stand overnight (overnight precipitation).

steps.title: Centrifuge and add warm SSTE
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat a water bath and a heat block to 60 °C, heat the SSTE buffer to 60 °C, and cool the centrifuge to –4 °C. Centrifuge the overnight‑incubated samples at 10,000 rpm for 30 min at –4 °C. Then add 700 µL of warm SSTE buffer to each pellet, pipet‑mix to resuspend (pellet may appear brown, faint, or be invisible).

steps.title: Third CHISAM wash and incubation
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube, incubate at 60 °C for 5–10 min to resuspend the pellet, invert gently, then centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 10 min at room temperature. Transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL tube; discard the remaining liquid.

steps.title: Fourth CHISAM wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube, centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 10 min at room temperature, and transfer the supernatant to a fresh 2 mL tube; discard the remaining liquid.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of cold absolute ethanol to each tube, then incubate at –80 °C for 1 h (use this time to prepare agarose gels). Meanwhile, cool the centrifuge to –4 °C.

steps.title: Pellet centrifugation and drying
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 30 min at –4 °C. Discard the supernatant, leaving the dry RNA pellet in the tube.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA in DEPC water
steps.instruction: Add 25–50 µL of DEPC‑treated water to the dry pellet (volume depends on expected RNA concentration). Keep the tubes on ice; avoid tilting the tube more than 90° to prevent disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: First 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 2 min at –4 °C, then discard the supernatant and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Second 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 700 µL cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 2 min at –4 °C, discard the supernatant, and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in the hood and allow the pellet to air‑dry until no visible ethanol remains (optional: use a P10 pipette to gently remove residual ethanol).

steps.title: Store RNA at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Seal the tubes and store the purified RNA at –80 °C.

steps.title: Optional RNA quality assessment
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration with a Nanodrop or Qubit, run an agarose gel, and assess integrity with a Bioanalyzer before library preparation.

steps.title: DNase treatment preparation
steps.instruction: Bring SPRI beads to room temperature and vortex thoroughly to fully resuspend. Dilute each RNA sample to 100 µL total volume (e.g., 16.6 µL RNA + water) aiming for >1 µg total RNA.

steps.title: Add DNase and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of DNase (any commercial kit) and 10 µL of 10× DNase buffer to each 100 µL RNA sample, mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add SPRI beads and bind
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL (2× sample volume) of SPRI beads, mix by vortex, spin down briefly, and incubate at room temperature for at least 5 min to allow RNA binding.

steps.title: Magnetic bead separation
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a magnetic rack for 5 min (or until the solution is clear). Gently move the tube up and down to gather all beads at the magnet side.

steps.title: First 80 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on the magnet, add 200 µL of freshly prepared 80 % ethanol, incubate at room temperature for 2 min without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Second 80 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 200 µL 80 % ethanol and 2‑min incubation (total of two washes).

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnet and air‑dry the beads for 3–5 min until no liquid remains and the bead pellet shows cracks.

steps.title: Elute purified RNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the dried beads at room temperature for 2 min, then place the tube back on the magnet until the supernatant is clear. Transfer 30 µL of the clear supernatant (purified RNA) to a new tube.

steps.title: RNA ready for library prep
steps.instruction: The eluted RNA is now purified and can be used directly for library preparation.
